prompt_en:
Goal: Create a whimsical cinematic snack advertisement poster for Oishi Potato Fries, themed as a magical fantasy amusement park called SNACK KINGDOM.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster composition, ultra-detailed, high-resolution, warm golden-hour lighting, saturated reds and yellows, energetic commercial photography mixed with fantasy illustration.

Main subject: Center a smiling young woman with glasses wearing a pink hoodie, seated inside an oversized red-and-yellow bucket filled with golden potato fries. Her face should be intentionally covered by a plain rectangular neutral-color placeholder, while her dark hair, ears, hands, and hoodie remain visible. She holds exactly 2 large fries, one upright in each hand.

Product and foreground: The giant bucket dominates the lower half of the image. On the bucket, show the readable logo text “Oishi” above large bold text “POTATO FRIES,” with small crown and star graphics. Fill the bucket with many thick golden fries, and add flying fries around the frame. Include exactly 14 prominent loose fries outside or above the bucket: 2 at the top left, 1 at the top right, 3 on the right side, 3 in the lower foreground, 3 around the left foreground, and 2 partly behind the subject near the bucket rim. Add glowing golden light trails swirling around the bucket and fries.

Background: Build a miniature fantasy theme park snack kingdom behind the subject, with a fairytale castle in the distance, a Ferris wheel on the right, colorful carnival tents and rides, warm lantern lights, tiny crowds, and a visible shop sign reading “SNACK CAFE.” Use shallow depth of field so the subject and bucket are sharp while the amusement park is slightly dreamy and cinematic.

Typography: At the top, place huge 3D cream-colored block letters spelling “SNACK KINGDOM,” outlined in brown with a red curved underline, and place a gold crown with a red jewel above the title. At the bottom, place a wooden sign with the slogan in bold white and yellow text: “MORE THAN A TREAT. IT’S JOY.”

Style constraints: Make it feel like a viral snack brand campaign poster: playful, magical, high-energy, appetizing, glossy, and richly lit. Keep all main text perfectly legible, avoid extra logos or watermarks, and preserve the exact visible text hierarchy.\

prompt_en:
Create a delicate contemporary Japanese lifestyle illustration with a cozy slice-of-life atmosphere.

ART STYLE
Hand-drawn pen-and-ink sketch illustration, thin expressive linework, loose imperfect contours, minimalist editorial artwork, soft watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, elegant negative space, sketchbook aesthetic, modern Japanese indie illustration, light and airy composition, contemporary café-art style, emotionally warm and intimate.

CHARACTERS
Two young adults with soft, simplified facial features and natural expressions. Casual oversized clothing, relaxed body language, authentic interaction, candid everyday moment. Faces are minimally rendered with delicate linework rather than detailed realism.

ENVIRONMENT
A cozy indoor setting such as a café, coffee shop, apartment, studio, bookstore, kitchen corner, or creative workspace. Include wooden furniture, coffee mugs, indoor plants, shelves, books, windows, soft decorative details, and small everyday objects. The environment should feel lived-in yet uncluttered.

COMPOSITION
Full-body or three-quarter-body view. Characters seated naturally and facing one another. Balanced asymmetrical layout. Large areas of clean negative space. Storytelling through posture and atmosphere rather than action. Editorial illustration framing. Eye-level perspective.

COLOR PALETTE
Muted and desaturated colors only:
• Dusty blue
• Warm cream
• Soft beige
• Light gray
• Sage green
• Warm brown
• Off-white

Add only one small red element such as red socks, red shoes, a red mug, or a small red object.

LIGHTING
Soft natural daylight entering through windows. Gentle ambient illumination. No dramatic shadows. Warm, peaceful, calming mood.

RENDERING
Minimal shading. Sparse details. Watercolor-style color fills inside delicate ink outlines. Slightly unfinished sketch quality. High-quality illustration with visible hand-drawn imperfections. Soft edges and subtle texture.

MOOD
Comfortable, quiet, nostalgic, peaceful, intimate, cozy, everyday happiness, slow living, café culture, thoughtful conversation, gentle human connection.

AVOID
Anime screenshots, manga panels, cel shading, digital painting, hyperrealism, photorealism, 3D rendering, glossy surfaces, vibrant saturated colors, cinematic effects, dramatic lighting, excessive details, sharp outlines, heavy shadows, complex backgrounds.

SCENE:
[INSERT YOUR SCENE DESCRIPTION HERE]

The final image should feel like a premium Japanese lifestyle illustration found in an art book, café magazine, design journal, or independent sketchbook collection.\

title: 石墙上的女孩和小狗
author: @MR. TARIQ
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,群像 / 情侣,动物 / 生物
prompt_en: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic portrait of a cute little girl and a golden retriever puppy peeking over an old rustic stone wall together. The girl is on the left and the puppy is on the right, both mostly hidden behind the wall, with only their heads, the girl's small fingers, and the puppy's tiny paws visible resting on the top edge. Use an eye-level camera angle and an intimate centered composition, with exactly two subjects. The stone wall should fill the lower half of the frame, made of rough beige sandstone blocks with visible mortar, cracks, and natural texture. Behind them, show a softly blurred countryside setting with an old stone building on the right, warm greenery on the left, and golden-hour sunlight glowing from the upper left. Use shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, warm amber color grading, realistic fur and hair detail, soft backlighting, gentle rim light, and a wholesome heartwarming mood. The girl should have long brown hair falling forward as she peeks shyly, while the puppy has fluffy golden ears and one paw draped over the wall. Photorealistic, cinematic lens look, 4:5 vertical portrait, no text, no watermark, no extra people or animals.\

title: 老式健身房里的坚韧拳击手
author: Harboris
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,肖像 / 自拍,网红 / 模特
prompt_en: A gritty realistic fitness lifestyle portrait of a male athlete leaning casually but strongly on the ropes of a boxing ring inside an old-school gym. Mid shot, vertical composition, centered subject from about mid-thigh to head, with both forearms resting on the top red ring rope and hands loosely draped forward above a white and blue lower rope. The subject wears an oversized heather grey hoodie with the hood up, soft cotton texture, natural folds, slightly worn casual look, and black athletic boxing shorts barely visible at the bottom of frame. Both hands are wrapped in slightly worn white boxing wraps with realistic fabric tension and layered wrapping around wrists, palms, and knuckles. Hair is dark, short-to-medium length, slightly wet, with a few natural strands visible under the hood on the forehead. Expression should feel focused, calm, slightly tired, and determined, with neutral lips and a thoughtful, post-training mood. Natural athletic build with realistic muscle definition under the hoodie, broad shoulders, no exaggerated musculature. Background is a vintage boxing gym with exactly 3 visible ring rope colors in frame: red top rope, white middle rope, blue lower rope. Behind the subject are worn off-white walls, aged boxing posters, hanging training gear, and soft blurred gym details that suggest history and use. Lighting is soft natural indoor light mixed with dim ambient gym lighting, creating gentle shadows, muted contrast, and a cinematic documentary feel. Shallow depth of field, sharp focus on hoodie texture, wrapped hands, and ring ropes, realistic skin and fabric detail, earthy muted tones, authentic analog-like atmosphere, no glamour retouching.\

prompt_en: Please create an Eastern fantasy character concept illustration featuring an Eastern fantasy character using a musical instrument or weapon. The overall style blends traditional Chinese Xianxia, mythological iconography, and movie-level CG concept art texture. The image has a strong Eastern fantasy aesthetic, high-level beauty, and an epic feel. The character is the core visual focus, with an ethereal, sacred, elegant, cold, or majestic temperament. Automatically match the most appropriate expression, clothing, hairstyle, accessories, and identity setting based on the character. If the item is a musical instrument, the character should be in a ritualistic and fluid posture such as playing, plucking, blowing, or standing with the instrument, emphasizing musical energy, spiritual flow, and sound waves turning into light patterns, clouds, starlight, or magic circles. If the item is a weapon, the character should be in a posture of holding the weapon, gathering momentum, confronting, casting spells, or the moment before battle, emphasizing the sense of power, pressure, aura, and energy convergence. The composition is mainly centered or off-center, balanced, solemn, and has a poster-level main visual effect; the character's back can have a moon wheel, a halo, divine light, an ancient array, or an icon-style circular structure. The clothing adopts an Eastern fantasy style with light and beautiful materials, including gauze, ribbons, layered hems, metal ornaments, jade ornaments, or crowns. Hair and fabric flow in the wind, creating a strong sense of dynamic beauty. The background is automatically matched to the character's temperament as Eastern fantasy scenes such as starry sky divine realm, cloud sea heaven, moonlit sacred land, bamboo forest fairy mountain, ice and snow secret realm, quiet night altar, ancient ruins, etc., with environment carrying mist, flowing light, particles, mysterious energy, and spatial depth. The color uses a unified and high-level main tone to control the screen. It can automatically choose ice blue, moon white, green, purple, red gold, ink black, silver gray and other color schemes according to the character and props, and use a small amount of light gold or cold light for divine embellishment. Overall requirements: beautiful, dreamy, ethereal, mysterious, detached, sacred, exquisite, with movie-level lighting and shadow, volumetric light, sense of air, ultra-detailed CG illustration texture; avoid vulgarity, avoid cheap ancient style photo sense, avoid internet celebrity faces, avoid cluttered backgrounds, avoid plastic textures.\

title: 城市自然观察展海报 - 1
author: @小小东
categories: 海报 / 传单,插画,极简主义,文字 / 排版,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical exhibition poster with a handmade silhouette-collage aesthetic for 城市自然观察室, combining rock specimen textures, black cut-paper hands, botanical details, and an orderly museum information system.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 3:4 ratio, off-white paper background with subtle grain, screen-print texture, slightly imperfect ink registration, muted blue-gray, slate, moss green, charcoal black, and white.

Layout: A tall irregular pale blue-gray vertical torn-paper shape runs down the center. Place the main title as huge stacked white Chinese block characters inside this central strip, reading from top to bottom, with a bold condensed geometric style. Around it, arrange specimens and hands in a balanced collage, leaving generous negative space.

Main visual elements: Use exactly 4 black silhouette hands: 1 left upper hand pinching a small blue stone, 1 left lower hand cupping a large green stone, 1 right upper hand pinching a dark stone, and 1 right lower hand holding a magnifying glass. Use exactly 14 visible stone/collage pieces: 1 blue textured stone near the upper left hand, 1 pale gray triangular paper-stone under it, 1 blue curved strip on the left middle, 1 large green oval stone in the lower left center, 1 light gray torn fragment at the lower left edge, 1 small dark gray stone near the bottom left, 1 blue polygon stone with a tiny white plant silhouette at upper right, 1 dark hanging stone below the upper right hand, 1 green stone at right middle, 1 narrow blue-gray strip to its lower right, 1 black oval stone at right middle, 1 horizontal dark gray rectangular specimen bar, 1 gray rock near the lower right, and 1 dark blue torn block at the bottom right. Add exactly 3 delicate botanical accents: a small white plant silhouette inside the upper-right blue stone, a fine white/blue plant sprig beside the large green stone, and small black fern stems near the bottom left.

Typography and text: Add small vertical side branding on the upper left with a simple mountain-like logo and the Chinese name 新美馆探索基地, plus tiny English text \
